description: Upgrade a team space to Team ($29/mo flat, unlimited members). While checkout isn't live, this starts a 14-day free trial right away (no card), once per team. If a tool returned a 402 with paywall.then.add, pass that handle as `add` and the teammate is added once the trial starts. If the result has a `url`, give it to the user to open (Stripe checkout). Only team owners can upgrade; others get recorded as a request to the owners.

add.description: Teammate to add once upgraded, e.g. '@ana'.

name: upgrade_team
title: Upgrade a team
